title: 420 Pipe Mug – Black
description: This mug pipe with a 420 design can hold up to 400 ml of liquid. The handle of this mug includes a built-in pipe where smokers can pack dry herb in to take a quick hit while drinking. It even features a carb hole for greater control over the size and force of the hits.
